title.zh: 将碧瑶市 New Lucban 描笼涯的 Pines City 国立中学－Magsaysay 附属校从该校分离，改设为名为 Magsaysay 国立中学的独立国立中学并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Pines City National High School - Magsaysay Annex in Barangay New Lucban, City of Baguio from the Pines City National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Magsaysay National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Pines City National High School - Magsaysay Annex in Barangay New Lucban, City of Baguio from the Pines City National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Magsaysay National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Magsaysay của Trường Trung học Thành phố Pines Quốc gia tại Barangay New Lucban, Thành phố Baguio khỏi Trường Trung học Thành phố Pines Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Magsaysay Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Magsaysay ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเมือง Pines แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ New Lucban เมือง Baguio ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเมือง Pines แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Magsaysay แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Magsaysay, Sekolah Menengah Kota Pines Nasional di Barangay New Lucban, Kota Baguio dari Sekolah Menengah Kota Pines Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Magsaysay Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Magsaysay, Sekolah Menengah Bandar Pines Kebangsaan di Barangay New Lucban, Bandar Baguio daripada Sekolah Menengah Bandar Pines Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Magsaysay Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Pines City National High School - Magsaysay Annex in Barangay New Lucban, City of Baguio is hereby separated from the Pines City National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Magsaysay National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Pines City National High School - Magsaysay Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Magsaysay National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Magsaysay National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Pines City National High School - Magsaysay Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
